readerCopy.body: A new plan becomes more believable when daily life no longer has to treat every step forward like an emergency. When the Moon conjoins the North Node, emotional needs and forward movement meet in the same arrangement, making sleep, food, home, family, care, and routine part of how well the change works. A direction that repeatedly requires exhaustion or displacement is underbuilt. Progress becomes more sustainable when the life carrying it can function too.
